topics.inclusion_rule: Speech or language decoders from neural or other biosignals that train one model on data pooled across participants, with or without participant-specific layers or embeddings. Boundary: a per-participant model that only reports results averaged over participants is excluded; transfer by fine-tuning from another participant counts; versions of one study count once.

EEG imagined, inner or covert speech decoders or detectors whose ledger records cross-subject training, held-out-subject testing, transfer learning, fine-tuning or calibration; classified by full-text pattern into fine-tuning or calibration on the target subject, zero-shot held-out-subject testing, per-subject-only training, domain adaptation and subject-cyclic training schedules. Boundary: reviews and datasets without a decoder are counted by the ledger pattern but carry no design; every named design counts (upper bound); versions of one study count once.
topics.pattern: EEG + imagined/inner/covert speech + cross-subject / LOSO / calibration / fine-tuning / transfer learning (ledger text)

topics.inclusion_rule: Include EEG imagined-speech detection studies that construct or align imagined-speech ground-truth labels using overt speech or another explicit reference source. Boundary: exclude overt-speech recognition where overt speech itself is the decoder input, and distinguish directly observed labels from timing labels transferred from a paired overt utterance.
topics.metric: Independent validation or agreement evidence for reference labels (higher).

topics.inclusion_rule: EEG decoding studies that report accuracy on subjects whose data were not used to train the decoder (leave-one-subject-out, a fixed set of held-out subjects, or subject-independent cross-validation). Boundary: within-subject cross-validation only, fine-tuning on the test subject's labeled trials before scoring (counted, but recorded as calibrated transfer), and reviews are excluded; versions of one study count once.

EEG imagined, inner or covert speech studies (ledger text), classified by full-text pattern into online or closed-loop operation, reported latency, reported calibration time and asynchronous (idle-state) detection. Boundary: reviews counted by the ledger pattern; a pattern hit in related work counts (upper bound); versions once.
